sql: SELECT y.trip_date, MAX(CASE WHEN y.trip_date = DATE '2025-01-20' THEN y.avg_total_amount END) AS target_avg_total_amount, AVG(CASE WHEN y.trip_date <> DATE '2025-01-20' THEN y.avg_total_amount END) AS baseline_avg_total_amount, MAX(CASE WHEN y.trip_date = DATE '2025-01-20' THEN y.trips END) AS target_trips, AVG(CASE WHEN y.trip_date <> DATE '2025-01-20' THEN y.trips END) AS baseline_avg_trips, d.d_day_name AS target_day, MAX(CASE WHEN y.trip_date = DATE '2025-01-20' THEN d.d_holiday END) AS target_d_holiday, MAX(CASE WHEN y.trip_date = DATE '2025-01-20' THEN h.is_national END) AS target_is_national FROM whybot.yellow_daily y JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date LEFT JOIN whybot.us_holidays h ON h.holiday_date = y.trip_date WHERE d.d_dow = 1 AND y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-01-31' GROUP BY y.trip_date ORDER BY y.trip_date LIMIT 31
